description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a whiteboard screen with drawing, erasing, undo, clear, pan/zoom, and color options. It implements an interactive canvas supporting multiple strokes, tool selection, and user interaction.

classes.name: WhiteboardScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing an interactive whiteboard interface.

classes.name: _WhiteboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the drawing logic, tools, and UI interactions for the WhiteboardScreen.

classes.name: Stroke
classes.description: Data class representing a series of points with associated paint style for a stroke.

classes.name: WhiteboardPainter
classes.description: CustomPainter class responsible for rendering the strokes onto the canvas.

methods.name: _startStroke
methods.description: Initializes a new stroke with current tool settings at a given position.

methods.name: _appendPoint
methods.description: Adds a point to the current stroke.

methods.name: _endStroke
methods.description: Finalizes the current stroke and adds it to the list of completed strokes.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears all strokes from the canvas.

methods.name: _undo
methods.description: Removes the last stroke from the drawing.

methods.name: _buildToolbar
methods.description: Builds the UI toolbar for tool selection, color palette, and undo/clear actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget layout including the toolbar and the drawing area.
